_readme: Curation defaults for the App Hub. Keyed by the portal-service registry id (stable forever — never a container id). Per-app keys: icon (emoji), name, launch_url, pinned, hidden, description. Runtime hide/pin toggles live in the DB overlay (agent_memory widget_state 'portal:overrides') and take precedence over this file. Apps listed here with no portal match become synthetic launch targets (status 'unknown'). To make a NEW service appear everywhere, add it to vault-service/projects.json — not here.
